run_sentence_transformer_training: run sentence transformer model training using a JSON training config file via the CLI
train_sentence_transformer_model: train a sentence transformer model with pair, triplet, or QA loss functions on a dataset
configure_sentence_transformer_loss: configure the loss function for sentence transformer training including MultipleNegativesRankingLoss, SoftmaxLoss, or CoSENTLoss
push_sentence_transformer_to_hub: push a trained sentence transformer model to the HuggingFace Hub after training completes
setup_sentence_transformer_evaluator: setup an EmbeddingSimilarityEvaluator or TripletEvaluator for validating sentence transformer model performance
